claim: A candidate cannot be calibration-ready when only 74 of 77 uprights map to roof faces, 70 map to attic compartments, and 44 lie above the candidate roof.
theorem:
def calibrationReady (uprights faceMapped compartmentMapped above : Nat) : Bool :=
  uprights == 77 && faceMapped == 77 && compartmentMapped == 77 && above == 0

theorem polarisCandidateRejected :
  calibrationReady 77 74 70 44 = false := by
  decide
